# Deploy MCP

> Autonomous Vercel Deployment Runtime for Model Context Protocol (MCP)
> Deploy your website in seconds directly from Cursor, Claude, Antigravity, or VS Code.

## Executive Summary
Deploy MCP is an open-source Model Context Protocol server that bridges AI editors directly with Vercel's Anycast Edge Network. Developers write prompts like "Deploy my project" in Cursor or Claude Desktop, and Deploy MCP autonomously validates the local build in under 2 seconds, safeguards environment secrets through local AST scanning, provisions Vercel deployments, streams logs, and diagnoses failures with automated fix recipes.

- **Website**: https://deploymcp.vercel.app/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Tusharjain-19/deploy-mcp
- **NPM Package**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/deploymcp
- **License**: MIT (100% Free & Open Source)
- **Creator**: Tushar Jain (https://tusharjain.in)
- **Protocol**: Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC over Stdio)

## Core Capabilities
- **Autonomous Multi-Stage Pipeline (`smart_deploy`)**: Automatic framework detection, local dry-run compile checks, Vercel edge deployment, live status polling, and self-healing build error diagnostics.
- **Zero-Trust Security Enclave**: Raw environment secrets and API keys are NEVER passed to LLM context windows. Variables are transmitted straight from local machine to Vercel via local TLS.
- **Sub-2-Second Local Build Checks**: Compiles Next.js, Vite, React, Astro, or Remix locally before upload to catch broken imports and syntax bugs before hitting cloud build quotas.
- **Self-Healing Diagnostics Studio**: Parses cloud build logs on failure, isolates the root problem, and generates copy-paste fix instructions directly in chat.
- **20 Governed MCP Tools**: Full lifecycle management covering project checks, deployments, environment variable syncing, custom domains, git health, and updates.

## Supported Environments
- **AI Editors**: Cursor, Claude Desktop, Google Antigravity, VS Code (Cline / Roo-Code), Windsurf.
- **Frameworks**: Next.js 13/14/15 (App Router & Pages Router), Vite React, Vue, SvelteKit, Remix, Astro, Static HTML.
- **Runtimes**: Node.js 18+, Edge Runtime, Serverless Functions.

## Quick Setup
```bash
npx deploymcp setup
```
Run `npx deploymcp setup` to verify your free Vercel Personal Access Token and automatically configure your AI editor's MCP settings file.

For the exhaustive 20-tool specification and parameter schemas, see:
https://deploymcp.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
